updates.title: 2 Denial of Service Vulnerabilities Patched in Azure Active Directory
updates.summary: Microsoft has published security updates for two denial-of-service vulnerabilities affecting Azure Active Directory (CVE-2026-50652 and CVE-2026-50653). Admins should review and apply patches to prevent potential service disruption from unauthenticated attackers.

updates.title: 4 Denial of Service Vulnerabilities Patched in Windows Active Directory Federation Services
updates.summary: Four denial-of-service vulnerabilities have been identified in Windows ADFS (CVE-2026-50304, CVE-2026-50368, CVE-2026-50324, CVE-2026-50355). Organizations using ADFS for federation should prioritize patching to maintain availability of identity services.

updates.title: 4 Security Vulnerabilities Patched in RabbitMQ
updates.summary: Microsoft has published updates for four RabbitMQ vulnerabilities including credential disclosure (CVE-2026-57219), memory exhaustion denial of service (CVE-2026-57220), cross-tenant authorization bypass (CVE-2026-57217), and stored XSS in the federation plugin (CVE-2026-57213). Organizations using RabbitMQ should apply patches to prevent credential theft, service outages, and cross-tenant access.

updates.title: New SOC Identity Responder Built-in Role
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra introduced the SOC Identity Responder role to enable security operations teams to execute identity containment actions from Microsoft Defender with minimal required privileges. This reduces the need for SOC analysts to hold multiple high-privilege roles or depend on identity administrators during incident response.

updates.title: Extended Conditional Access Protections for AI Agent User Accounts
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra Conditional Access now supports targeting and protecting AI agent user accounts with greater precision using Custom Security Attributes and agent-risk policies. Admins can now apply conditional policies specifically to agents, closing a security gap for service principal accounts used by automation and AI systems.

updates.title: Microsoft Entra Backup and Recovery Generally Available
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra Backup and Recovery is now generally available, automatically backing up critical directory objects including users, groups, applications, policies, and named locations. This built-in solution helps organizations recover from accidental or malicious changes without external tooling.

updates.title: Jailbreak/Root Detection in Authenticator App Generally Available
updates.summary: Microsoft Authenticator now blocks users with rooted or jailbroken devices from adding or using work or school accounts. This security-by-default feature reduces attack surface by preventing compromised mobile devices from accessing corporate resources.

updates.title: External Users Can Be Directly Assigned to Access Packages
updates.summary: Entitlement Management now allows admins to directly assign external users to access packages using their email address without pre-existing directory entries. External users are automatically invited as guests and governed by Entra ID Governance, simplifying partner and vendor access provisioning.

updates.title: Domainless SAML IdP Federation for Workforce Tenants
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra B2B now supports domainless SAML federation, allowing external users to authenticate using their IdP credentials regardless of email domain matching. This eliminates complex domain-matching configuration requirements for organizations with diverse email domains.

updates.title: AD Group Enforcement for Cloud Sync (Preview)
updates.summary: Entra Cloud Sync now supports AD group enforcement, allowing admins to designate specific Active Directory groups that can only be modified through Entra provisioning. This prevents unauthorized changes and maintains consistency between cloud and on-premises group management.

updates.title: SCIM 2.0 APIs for Microsoft Entra ID in US Gov Cloud
updates.summary: SCIM 2.0 APIs are now generally available in the US Gov cloud, enabling standards-based user and group provisioning for government organizations. This provides an industry-standard alternative for identity lifecycle management in restricted cloud environments.

updates.title: DLP File Quarantine Action for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention now supports file quarantine for SharePoint and OneDrive, automatically moving flagged files to an admin-controlled restricted location. This provides immediate containment of sensitive data while preserving files for investigation and review.

updates.title: DLP and Auto-labeling for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention and auto-labeling now extend to non-Microsoft applications including Google Workspace, Box, Dropbox, Salesforce, and AWS. Organizations can now enforce consistent data protection policies across their entire cloud application ecosystem.

updates.title: DLP Protection for External Emails in Microsoft 365 Copilot
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now prevents Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from processing emails from senders external to the organization. This real-time control mitigates data leakage risks by blocking sensitive information from being processed by AI systems via untrusted external communications.

updates.title: DLP Protection Against Sensitive Data in Copilot Web Search
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now prevents Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data in external web searches. This control helps organizations mitigate oversharing and data leakage risks by blocking sensitive information from being sent to external search engines.

updates.title: DLP Copilot Processing Control Extended to All Storage Locations
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP policies that restrict Copilot processing of sensitivity-labeled files now apply regardless of file storage location. Previously limited to specific storage types, this expansion ensures consistent data protection across all file repositories.

updates.title: Auto-labeling Scale Increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive is increasing from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day. This enables organizations to label and protect more data at rest faster, closing labeling gaps before Copilot rollout.

updates.title: DLP Event Data Enrichment in Defender Alerts Graph API
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP data is now available through the Defender Alerts Graph API alongside alert data, streamlining SIEM integration and automated workflow creation. This centralized access point eliminates the need to pull DLP event details from separate Management APIs.

updates.title: Data Security Investigations Integration with Endpoint DLP Alerts
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Data Security Investigations can now be launched directly from endpoint DLP alerts, automatically gathering related files triggered by policies. This accelerates investigation workflows by correlating exfiltration events without manual file discovery.

updates.title: DLP Integration with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to intercept and inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, preventing sensitive data from reaching untrusted cloud applications. This provides network-level enforcement complementing application-level policies.
